items.docs:
Submits feedback for a specific conversation. Use this endpoint to collect user ratings and comments about the quality of AI responses. Feedback helps improve the service and can be used for quality monitoring.

**Rating Options:**
- `up`: Positive feedback indicating a helpful response
- `down`: Negative feedback indicating an unsatisfactory response

**Optional Fields:**
- `message_id`: Target specific message within the conversation
- `comment`: Additional text feedback from the user

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the conversation to delete feedback for

params.name: message_id
params.description: The specific message ID whose feedback should be deleted. If omitted, the last message's feedback is deleted.

items.docs: Deletes feedback for a specific conversation. If `message_id` is not provided, the feedback from the last message in the conversation will be deleted.
